fieldData.job-spec:
What is the role?

RDX is looking for an experienced Chief of Staff for a 12 month maternity cover contract. Working closely with our CEO and Leadership Team, you will act as the right hand of the CEO ensuring key company communications, plans and actions are shared and acted upon by the team. You will be the point of reference for the majority of operational queries, requests and issues and will play an integral part of the company's workforce and management team.

This role will start early March 2022, involving a 3 month handover with the Chief of Staff, 7 months maternity cover (June - December 2022) and then a 2 month handover when the Chief of Staff returns to work in January 2023. The contract will end around the end of February 2023.

What will you be doing?

  • You will have a flexible attitude and be willing to jump into various roles depending on the shifting needs of the business and the team
  • You will work with the talent lead and people manager to ensure our people are well looked after and any new roles are pushed over to the talent lead to fill, as well as new people are onboarded in a timely manner
  • You will plan and execute events, including whole company gatherings
  • Work closely with VP of Operations on legal and regulatory compliance and monitor compliance with laws and regulations
  • You will work closely with our CEO to ensure calls and projects run smoothly, as well as shadow him on strategy calls

What do you need?

  • Prior experience in a Chief of Staff role, beneficial
  • Prior experience in operations management necessary
  • Prior experience in working in startup, ideally through a growth period
  • Knowledge of operations management systems, processes and procedures
  • Proficiency in G Suite
  • Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritise work effectively
  • A flexible approach, with the ability to adapt to changing requirements
  • Great attention to detail with strong problem-solving skills
  • The ability to manage heavy workloads effectively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to multitask
  • A high degree of professionalism and the ability to communicate with senior-level internal and external executives
  • Enthusiasm for working in a small, entrepreneurial company
  • A Bachelor’s degree

Who are we?

You’ve heard of Bitcoin (BTC) - the world’s first decentralized peer-to-peer digital money system - and Ethereum (ETH) - the decentralized computer for the world. Radix (XRD) builds on these concepts to deliver the decentralized infrastructure for global finance (aka decentralised finance, “DeFi”) with the Radix network.

At Radix, we're a team of like-minded thinkers who believe we’re at the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. DeFi is already enabling pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, without requiring central authorities or siloed infrastructure.

DeFi has grown assets under management from $1 billion to $100 billion in less than a year. Impressive as its growth has been, its current market size isn't even a rounding error on the over $111 trillion held in traditional finance. However, the current decentralized public ledgers DeFi is running on are hampered with fundamental challenges in scaling and parallelisation of transactions.

At Radix, we’ve gone back to first principles to develop the right technical solution—the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi. Clearly the need for an infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite for mass adoption, so we're also blazing new ground in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration.

We're focused on delivering the technology to take DeFi from billions to trillions. We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like. We need you to join the team to help bring this vision to reality.

If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply here or email farrah@rdx.works for more information.
